title: The Stamp Act of 1765 is a British tax statute on the colonies
summary: Avalon prints the Stamp Act of 22 March 1765 as a parliamentary tax statute.
body: Avalon prints the Stamp Act of 22 March 1765, a statute imposing stamp duties in the American colonies. The page is the statute. Colonial resolutions against it are separate documents. The wording on the page includes: "1899 20th Century 1900 - 1999 21st Century 2000 - Great Britain : Parliament - The Stamp Act, March 22, 1765 An act for granting and applying certain stamp duties, and other duties, in the British colonies and plantations in America, towards further defraying the expences of defending, protecting, and securing the same; and for amending such parts".
